review_meta.eligibility: Oregon DERP ADHD pharmacologic treatments review: pediatric/adult outpatients with ADD/ADHD; listed stimulants/non-stimulants/antidepressants/antihypertensives/atypicals; symptom/functional/QoL/AE outcomes; controlled trials, good SRs, observational with functional/AE outcomes; exclude wrong outcome/drug/population/publication type/design/duration (Cohen codes 2–7).
review_meta.fairness: TIAB gold (Abstract Triage) ↔ title+abstract only. Never claim against Article Triage / full-text labels.
review_meta.wss95_footnote: Cohen 2006 reported large WSS@95 for ADHD with their ML classifier (~≥50%); historical footnote only — not our headline metric.

fairness: Gold = Abstract Triage (I=include). Evidence = MEDLINE title+abstract via PMID. Never Article Triage / full-text labels.
